:::::: resource-section
### Open science practice

::::: resource-grid
::: resource-card
#### [BES guides](https://www.britishecologicalsociety.org/content-type/better-science-guides/)

Guides from the British Ecological Society on research excellence, including data management and reproducible coding.
:::

::: resource-card
#### [BioST\@TS](https://biostats-r.github.io/biostats/)

Online platform for writing a thesis in R: working in R, Git/GitHub, Quarto, targets, and making R packages.
:::
:::::
::::::
